data.training_policy: all HWRT official train rows + only non-validation UJI official train writers
data.validation_policy: selected 8 writer groups from UJI official train split; 20 official test writers untouched

comparison.objective: equal 372-way CE; no teacher distillation and no explicit margin term
comparison.input_contract: 128x5 points, uniform-time channel; identical rows and sampler per arm
comparison.interpretation_limit: UJI writer-generalization diagnostic for the 97-class overlap only; not full 372-class or formula-level acceptance
